verdict.rationale: The official CLI clearly runs headlessly, with non-interactive invocations such as `trufflehog git file://. --since-commit HEAD --results=verified,unknown --fail`, `--only-verified`, and Docker runs. Its verified/unknown result filtering helps an agent separate real findings from noise. However, the evidence never documents a machine-readable (e.g. JSON) output mode an agent could parse, and issue filing appears only as Enterprise routing to Jira, Slack, or webhooks rather than a CLI-driven workflow. Missing for 10: documented JSON/structured output, evidence of agent-driven issue creation from CLI results, independent hands-on corroboration of an agent workflow.
